We need to perform the steps defined in SOUL.md: fetch multiple RSS feeds, filter to today's articles (within last 24h), find a primary topic covered by at least two sources, then extract article content via Jina AI (curl to https://r.jina.ai/<article_url>). Validate URLs not 404. Then produce JSON.

We need to perform network requests. Use exec with curl. Let's fetch the feeds. We need at least 3, but the SOUL includes 4 sources. We'll fetch all four.

Or more robust: lower case title, check if any other source title contains same main keywords (like same phrase). For simplicity, maybe check if any two titles have a common word longer than, say, 4 characters.

We'll then pick the first matching pair.

Then for each chosen article, validate URL via curl -o /dev/null -s -w "%{http_code}" URL.

Then fetch content via Jina AI: curl -s "https://r.jina.ai/<article_url>" --max-time 20.

Collect raw content for each.

Combine to JSON structure as required.
